decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans and information submitted (Site plan, ZAMPL01 - pages 1, 2, and 3 received 30.04.12) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Anti-vibration mountings and a three-stage filtration system, comprising grease, pre-filter and carbon absorption stages should be incorporated in the system and should be regularly maintained.

Condition : 4 - The extractor flue hereby approved shall not be operated until details of a scheme to control the emission of noise from the extract fan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times [10am - 9pm, Monday to Saturday and 10am - 9pm on Sundays and Bank Holidays.'].
description: Part change of use from A1 to A5 and the installation of an extractor flue pipe.
